[[File:Jinda_Ewoks.jpg|thumb|right|250px|"Jinda" Ewoks.]]
'''Jinda''' was a derogatory term used by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] to describe others of their [[Species/Legends|species]] who shunned their traditional sedentary lifestyle in favor of a nomadic way of life. The term was a reference to the [[Travelling Jindas]], a group of the non-native [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda species]] who lived a nomadic existence on Endor.
